Priya —

Thanks for the order form. We did an initial review and have a few redlines from Legal. High level:
- Term: we prefer an 18-month term (6/1/28 - 11/30/29) instead of 12 months to align with our budgeting cadence.
- SLA: clarify credit calculation — Legal wants a cap on cumulative credits at 15% of monthly fees and explicit measurement method (p99 observed over rolling 30d).
- Data: need DPA + SCC references for any EU traffic; also request retention window for logs be limited to 90 days unless otherwise agreed.
- Indemnity/liability: request carve-out for third-party IP claims caused by customer prompts; also cap liability at 2x fees for direct damages.
- Termination: require 60 days' cure period for material breach and a 30-day termination-for-convenience with pro-rated refund.

We attached annotated MSA to this reply (legal team). If Redwood can accept term change to 18 months and confirm the SLA credit cap and retention limit, we can try to move quickly. Otherwise Legal will push more edits.

Tim

--

Head of Platform Partnerships | SilverLake Analytics

Subject: Fwd: Renewal: SilverLake order form - term change & MSA redlines

Aditya / Monica —

Forwarding SilverLake's legal redlines. TL;DR: they want 18 months, SLA credit cap 15%/month, 90d retention for logs, and tighter indemnity carve-outs.

Quick thoughts:
- Term: 18 months increases ARR predictability but delays next upsell event. We could accept 18 months if we add a step-up pricing clause at month 12 (e.g., +8% thereafter) and an expansion option at month 9.
- SLA: 15% cap is reasonable but need to confirm measurement (p99 rolling 30d) and whether market practice ties credits to actual token/throughput loss. Ask SRE for the formula.
- Data retention/DPA: OK to accept 90-day logs; however we need exceptions for forensic/audit holds (with customer's notice and agreed process).
- Indemnity/liability: push back on prompt-caused IP carve-out — our policy is no carve-outs for outputs unless demonstrable customer-provided content. Counter-proposal: maintain 2x fee cap but expressly exclude willful misconduct.

Can you two weigh in on approach? If we agree, I'll draft clean counter and propose a DocuSign timeline.

Priya
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: SilverLake order form - term change & MSA redlines

Priya / Monica —

I synced with SRE and Legal on the key technical/measurement points:
- SLA measurement: we can commit to p99 measured at the edge over a rolling 30-day window. Credits calculated as percentage of monthly invoice proportional to downtime impacting reserved pool, capped at 15% of that month's fee (fine).
- Logs/retention: 90 days is OK; add carve for forensic holds with customer's written request and scope-limited exports.
- Indemnity: Legal will not accept a broad prompt-based IP carve-out. We can add a narrow customer-responsibility clause for knowingly uploaded infringing content and require customer to indemnify in that narrow case.
- Pricing/term: if we accept 18 months, propose pricing language: fixed rates for first 9 months, then a single step-up at month 10 of +7%. Also require an early-expansion trigger: if they increase reserved capacity by >20% prior to month 12, pricing rebalancing will occur.

If Priya agrees, I can prepare a redline set that reflects these counters. We should also prep a short internal note for Customer Success to plan onboarding in May/June.

Aditya
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: timothy.lang@silverlake.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, contracts@silverlake.com
Date: 2028-04-02T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SilverLake order form - term change & MSA redlines

Tim —

Thanks for the redlines and the quick turnaround. We can accept most of the requests with the following clean counters (attached will be updated MSA/order form):
1) Term: Accept 18-month term (6/1/28 - 11/30/29) on the condition of a one-time price step-up of +7% starting month 10 and an optional expansion review at month 9.
2) SLA: Agree to p99 measured over rolling 30 days; credits capped at 15% of monthly fees as requested. We will include formula language tying credits to percentage of affected reserved pool.
3) Data retention/DPA: Accept 90-day log retention; add process for forensic holds (customer writes scope + timeframe; Redwood responds within 5 business days). SCCs/DPA to be attached as exhibit.
4) Indemnity/liability: Maintain liability cap at 2x fees; add narrow customer indemnity if customer knowingly supplies infringing material. No broad prompt carve-out.
5) Termination: Clarify cure periods — 60 days for material breach; 30 days' termination for convenience with pro-rata refund for unused prepaid fees.

We will attach a clean MSA with track changes and the revised order form. If SilverLake can confirm these items today, we'll push for a DocuSign package by EOD 4/3 to meet the sign-by target.

Priya

Priya —

Appreciate the fast follow. SilverLake Legal and Finance reviewed your counters and provisionally agree to the compromises you outlined with two follow-ups:
- We want the step-up to be applied only once (month 10) and to be capped at +7% (ok). Please include example calculation in order form.
- For the forensic hold exception, we need a defined maximum extension of retention (up to 12 months) but only with explicit court order or regulator notice; otherwise limited to 90 days.

If you include those clarifications in the clean MSA/order form, SilverLake will sign. Please send DocuSign link once updated.

Thanks — moving to execution phase.

Timothy
Head of Platform Partnerships | SilverLake Analytics
